summary: security checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview; evidence_needed for the underlying control set. Exact decision: retain searchwoot.com as private and authorize no public exposure, monetization expansion, credential, access-control, telemetry, infrastructure, schedule, deployment, or data-handling changes this cycle. Concrete evidence: the read-only security baseline has no completed fleet-doctor run, operations deployment/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, legal-family security status is unknown for all 59 sites, and only HTTPS—not complete TLS configuration—is evidenced. Public inspection shows a password-gated, noindex/nofollow private preview, but does not establish authentication strength, authorization boundaries, secret storage or rotation, runtime isolation, release approvals, dependency controls, monitoring, incident response, data minimization/retention, or security.txt/disclosure readiness. Risk severity is high for public exposure and evidence_needed for control assurance. Missing telemetry is not evidence of compromise or a clean bill of health. Existing approved Great American Lakes measurement and separately authorized low-risk reversible work may continue; optional hardening alone does not block ordinary growth.

Required evidence before reconsidering go-live: owner-approved documentation of authentication and authorization boundaries; secrets storage, access, and rotation; container/runtime isolation; release and deploy approvals with rollback; complete TLS configuration; dependency and supply-chain controls; data flows, minimization, and retention; monitoring and incident signals; incident-response ownership; and security.txt or equivalent disclosure readiness. Evidence collection must remain read-only where possible and must not create credentials, alter access controls, deploy, or expose new data.

No security-sensitive implementation proposal is retained this cycle. No implementation.security_review approval is issued because no go-live or security-sensitive proposal is retained. Continue only existing approved measurement and narrowly scoped reversible queue metadata work; do not declare launch readiness from absent evidence.
